How we got here

Our story

  1. 2012 · Mumbai

    Two names, side by side

    We met at college in Mumbai, seated next to each other for no better reason than where our names fell on the list. Same batch, same classrooms, the same early chapters — and a friendship that started that first day.

  2. 2012–2025 · The long middle

    Nearly fourteen years

    Our paths took a different turn back then, but the bond held. For close to fourteen years we stayed in each other’s lives, through everything that happened in between.

  3. 2025 · A second chance

    Finding our way back

    Life gave us a second chance. We reconnected and started dating seriously — this time with the same intention on both sides: to build a future together.

  4. 29 March 2026 · The question

    The proposal

    A brick terrace on a bright afternoon at the end of March, the trees still bare and the first bulbs just up. Gaurish asked. Steffy said yes.

  5. 2026 · The day

    21 November

    Forty of our favourite people, one long table, and the two of us finally saying it out loud. We would love for you to be there.

For guests from out of town

Travel & stay

Getting here. Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) is about 25–30 minutes away by car. We’d suggest either renting a car or using Uber or Lyft — rideshares are easy to find at the airport and right across the Charlotte area, though a car of your own is worth it if you’d like to explore Lake Norman or Charlotte while you’re here.

Where to stay. A few places close to the venue:

  • Homewood Suites by Hilton Davidsonabout 8 minutes
  • Aloft Charlotte Lake Normanabout 10 minutes
  • Courtyard by Marriott Charlotte Lake Normanabout 10 minutes

Getting around. Peninsula Prime is roughly 8–10 minutes by taxi or rideshare from most of the Cornelius and Davidson hotels. Uber and Lyft are widely available in the area, so getting to and from the celebration should be straightforward.

Make a weekend of it. If you’re staying a little longer, a few of our local favourites:

  • Morning coffeeSummit Coffee in downtown Davidson — good local coffee and an unhurried place to sit.
  • A scenic walkJetton Park in Cornelius, for lakefront trails and views out over Lake Norman.
  • Sunday breakfastToast Cafe in Davidson or Famous Toastery in Cornelius, for a proper classic breakfast.

Good to know

Questions

Can I bring a guest?

We’re keeping things to forty people, so we’ve addressed the invitation to the names on your RSVP. If we’ve included a plus-one, it’ll say so on the form.

Are children welcome?

While we love your little ones, our micro-wedding reception is designed as an adult-focused evening in an intimate private restaurant space. The evening includes a curated dinner, interactive games and a DJ set all intended for adult enjoyment, so we kindly ask that you make arrangements for the night.

What should I wear?

We’d love to see our family and friends dress up with us — the dress code is cocktail or festive attire. Whether you go for Western cocktail wear or South Asian festive attire, we want you to feel comfortable, elegant and ready to celebrate. A quick guide if it helps:

  • Women · WesternCocktail-length dresses, midi dresses, dressy jumpsuits, or elegant evening separates.
  • Women · South AsianSarees (draped or pre-stitched), light lehengas, Anarkalis, or fusion wear.
  • Men · WesternA dark or neutral suit — navy, charcoal, grey — or a tailored blazer with dress trousers and a shirt. Ties optional.
  • Men · South AsianKurta-pyjama sets with a tailored Nehru jacket or Modi vest.

Footwear. The whole celebration is indoors, with carpeted flooring on the main level and a well-lit indoor staircase up to the mezzanine. There’s no grass or gravel to cross, so wear your favourite heels or dress shoes and be comfortable.

Is it indoors or outdoors?

Entirely indoors. We’re in a private dining space with a carpeted main level and an indoor staircase up to the mezzanine, so nothing depends on the weather.
